Amends the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 to add statutory prohibitions on FCC licensing.
dimensions.evidence: The Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 (47 U.S.C. 1601 et seq.) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent prohibition on future grants of specified licenses and authorizations, with FCC rules required within one year.
dimensions.evidence: shall apply with respect to the grant of a license, petition, or authorization on or after the date of enactment of this Act.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill prohibits the FCC from granting certain satellite licenses, market access, or earth station authorizations to specific foreign entities of concern and their affiliates listed on the FCC Covered List. It amends the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 and directs the FCC to issue rules within one year.
